entities.name: Bori Andon
entities.description: A reckless Izzet guildmage and blastseeker on Ravnica, wanted by the Azorius.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild that hunted Bori for his destructive experiments.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild whose Kalnika operation wanted Bori and later aimed to use his skills.

entities.name: Izmagnus Micas Vay
entities.description: Izzet leader who protected Bori and set him the Theorem task.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The Izzet dragon claimed to have given Bori the task.

entities.name: Theorem of Simultaneous Discordance
entities.description: Rumored impossible problem of one person ringing all seven bells of the Kalnika Quarter.

entities.name: Kalnika Quarter
entities.description: District with seven great bell towers.

entities.name: Dome of the Black Dove
entities.description: A glorious dome damaged by Bori's cyclone and later crumbled.

events.summary: Bori launched a viashino through the Harmony Basilica window and his Ossmorpher disintegrated the Veil Theatre.
events.quote: Bori launched a viashino through the priceless stained-glass window at the Harmony Basilica

events.summary: Izmagnus Vay protected Bori and halted his projects, assigning him the Theorem of Simultaneous Discordance.
events.quote: the council halted Bori's projects and instead gave him a special task

events.summary: Bori visited his friend Zaba, who gave him the route between the seven towers.
events.quote: Bori first visited his friend, the mapmaker Zaba

events.summary: Bori's cyclone damaged the Dome of the Black Dove and a mass mind attack revealed Dimir conduits.
events.quote: He set off a cyclone that damaged the Dome of the Black Dove

events.summary: Bori exploded the Dimir conduits and the dome crumbled; a vampire enforcer caught him but he escaped, and the Dimir decided to use his skills.
events.quote: the Dimir reassessed Bori's capabilities and decided to turn his skills to their cause instead of killing him outright

events.summary: Bori activated all seven bells at once, solving the Theorem.
events.quote: finally managed to activate all seven bells at once using his device

events.summary: Bori received a standing ovation and a tiny silver bell that would let the Dimir manipulate his mind.
events.quote: he received a standing ovation for having solved the Theorem

relations.quote: Bori Andon is a well-respected Nivix guildmage and Izzet blastseeker on Ravnica
Prime Izmagnus Micas Vay and his council safeguarded Bori Andon from the Azorius who hunted for him
Bori first visited his friend, the mapmaker Zaba
